answers.why: Ephraim names the camp organized by armies under its standard.
Israel is the community whose firstborn humans and animals were consecrated at the exodus.
Israel has chiefs who join Moses and Aaron in numbering the Levites.
The princes of Israel are explicitly identified as leaders of the tribes.
Israel's princes supply the twelve sets of offerings for the altar's dedication.
Israel consists of thousands whose leaders assemble at the trumpet signal.
The promised good concerns the people traveling with Moses to the land God will give them.
Israel is the multitude of thousands to whom Moses asks the LORD to return.
Israel's seventy elders are explicitly called elders and officers of the people.
Israel's elders return with Moses to the camp of the people.
Levi is named as Kohath's father in Korah's personal genealogy.
The God of Israel separates the Levites from the nation's congregation for service.
Israel names the congregation from which the Levites were set apart.
Israel's elders follow Moses to Dathan and Abiram before he addresses the congregation.
All Israel nearby flee and speak together in fear that the earth will swallow them.
